description: The line plot titled "Performance w.r.t. Temperature" illustrates the relationship between temperature and accuracy for three different methods: On-policy RL, LUFY, and SFT. The x-axis, labeled "Temperature," is a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick labels at every 0.1 interval. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy (Pass@8)," is also a linear scale ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, with tick labels at every 2.5 interval. The On-policy RL line, represented by yellow triangles, shows a fluctuating trend with peaks and troughs, starting at approximately 67.5 and ending around 72.5. The LUFY line, depicted by red stars, generally trends upward, starting near 75.0 and ending close to 80.0. The SFT line, shown with blue diamonds, exhibits a more variable pattern, beginning around 72.5 and concluding near 75.0. The plot does not include any shaded areas or other graphical elements.
